request.input:
Segment the document below into its numbered clauses, however many there are (use each clause's printed number as ref). Page markers like `--- page 2 ---` separate pages; never quote them, but cover every page: a new page starts new clauses, never a continuation of the previous page's clause. Call emit_extraction exactly once with ALL clauses and facts in that call. Quote each clause body verbatim: copy the exact characters, do not reword, summarise, or fix punctuation. For each clause give exactly one candidate fact: a concise statement of the clause's operative content, with clause_ref naming its clause and structured carrying at least {"clause_ref": ref} plus any numbers, dates, time limits, or party roles stated in the clause.

--- page 1 ---

9.2 Transfer logs
Nimbus shall keep transfer logs for review. Beacon may audit the logs on request. Transfers outside India need prior written approval. Breach notices go out within seventy-two hours.

--- page 2 ---

8.4 Scanned retention clause
Stratus shall notify Beacon of a Personal Data Breach within seventy-two hours. Beacon may appoint an auditor on thirty days notice.
